scope: Three-product research sample for US accounting firms; not an exhaustive ranking or hands-on review.

digits-ledger.title: Digits help: adding your first client

products.name: Double
products.fit: Explore if your team wants a shared place to review and close clients’ existing books.

ledger.text: Connects to QuickBooks Online and Xero for file review.

workflow.text: Groups bank transactions for review and categorization.

review.text: Review suggested coding; investigate uncertain transactions.

limit.text: AI Bank Feeds currently supports US QuickBooks Online files only. Xero file review does not imply Xero AI Bank Feeds support.

pricing.text: Per-client plans. Confirm the current amount and feature tier; base plan amounts were not reliably extractable in this review.

questions: Which features work for each client’s ledger and region?
Will separate bank connections be needed?
Which plan covers the specific workflow we want?
unknowns: Observed accuracy and time saved on real client books
Suitability for the firm’s particular client mix

products.name: Botkeeper
products.fit: Explore if you want transaction automation while keeping the client’s existing ledger.

ledger.text: GL Automation works with QuickBooks Online or Xero.

workflow.text: Uses transactions from the connected ledger’s accounts.

review.text: Vendor says high-confidence items can post automatically; lower-confidence items go to review.

limit.text: The software-only license is administered by your firm. Do not assume a dedicated accountant is included.

pricing.text: $149 per client license/month for 1–4 licenses on monthly billing. Volume and annual rates differ; services require separate scoping.

questions: Which transactions can post without our approval?
What is included in software versus additional services?
How do we handle exceptions and correct posted entries?
unknowns: Service package pricing for this firm

products.name: Digits
products.fit: Explore if your firm is willing to move selected clients onto a different accounting platform.

ledger.text: Start new books in Digits or migrate from an existing system.

workflow.text: Vendor describes automated bookkeeping, reconciliation and firm-wide review workflows.

review.text: Firm console supports oversight; exact approval controls need a trial.

limit.text: QuickBooks migration is an onboarding path, not proof of ongoing two-way ledger synchronization.

pricing.text: Business plans list Essentials at $65/month and Core at $100/month. Firm partner pricing must be checked separately.

questions: Which history and client workflows can we migrate?
What remains manual for our client mix?
What are the applicable firm plan and migration terms?
unknowns: Migration completeness for a real client
Observed exception handling and approval behavior
